integrity.ambient_equality_basis: The complete-sequence criterion for positive integer subset sums is proved by interval induction.
integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic C* actions; projectivity identifies it with ordinary topological Euler characteristic.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: Under the diagonal one-parameter subgroup, ambient fixed points are monomials; unique factorization shows that a monomial lies in Delta_lambda exactly when its y-exponent is a subset sum of the parts.
integrity.object_basis: The archival source defines X_lambda as the projective subvariety of binary forms factoring with root multiplicities prescribed by lambda and gives its standard projective parameterization.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The full archival source arXiv:math/0110224 lists Mathematics Subject Classification 14L30 first and treats the projective coincident root locus as its principal object.

scientific_limitations: The theorem determines ordinary Euler characteristic only; it does not determine Betti numbers, intersection cohomology, or singularity type.
The exact open stratum with root multiplicities precisely lambda is not computed.
The fixed-point proof is short, so an older or unindexed observation under discriminant-stratum terminology remains possible.
title: Euler characteristic of a coincident root locus is its subset-sum count
